description: React and Angular GIF pickers, a typed JavaScript client, Vue and Svelte examples, an importable n8n search workflow, and links to native Swift and Android SDKs.
rules: Install the published npm packages: npm install @rowix/gifsnap-react (React 0.1.2), npm install @rowix/gifsnap-js (JavaScript 0.1.0), or npm install @rowix/gifsnap-angular (Angular 0.1.0). npm resolves Angular's JavaScript dependency automatically.
Render the full returned url for animation. preview_url can be static. Preserve IDs, complete URLs and source metadata; optional content_id is an opaque identity hint.
React uses GifPicker and a styles.css import. Angular uses standalone GifSnapPicker without a global CSS import. The JavaScript package is a client, not a Vue or Svelte component library.
Use page and pagination.next_page for pagination; preserve raw API counts. Handle errors, cancellation and empty pages. No SLA, quota or media-license guarantee is provided.
HTTP base: https://gifsnap.com/api/v1. Exact GET routes: /gifs/search, /gifs/trending, /stickers/search and /stickers/trending. Keep the gifs/ or stickers/ segment.
SDK search uses query; HTTP search uses q. Both use page and limit. signal is a local Fetch option, never an HTTP query parameter.

createGifSnapClient() needs no arguments. baseUrl, fetch and timeoutMs are optional. Default baseUrl: https://gifsnap.com/api/v1. React has search/trending only; JavaScript/Angular also have searchStickers/trendingStickers.
